description:

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. ------------

MSB, Singapore (990 Bendemeer Road)

**Department**
--------------

MSBH Facilities

**Project Title**
-----------------

**AI-Powered Sustainability Command Center**

**Project Description**
-----------------------

The intern will undertake a structured engineering project focused on developing an AI-Powered Sustainability Command Center for selected energy, water, utility, cost, and carbon datasets.

Under the guidance of experienced engineering and digital professionals, the intern will assess existing data sources and reporting processes, develop a structured and reliable data model, and create an interactive dashboard for sustainability performance monitoring.

The project will also explore analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and automation methods for anomaly detection, insight generation, opportunity prioritization, and reporting. AI-generated outputs will remain traceable to source data and subject to appropriate engineering validation.

**Objective of the Project**
----------------------------

* Consolidate agreed sustainability and utility datasets into a structured and reliable data model.
* Develop an interactive command-center dashboard for operational and management visibility.
* Apply rule-based analytics or AI-Assisted methods to identify anomalies, trends, and improvement opportunities.
* Automate selected sustainability reporting and opportunity-tracking activities.
* Prepare clear technical documentation, user instructions, and solution-maintenance guidance.

**Opportunities for Full Time Employment**
------------------------------------------

High-performing interns may be considered for future internship or full-time employment opportunities, subject to business requirements, position availability, and the applicable selection process.

**Project Scope**
-----------------

* Assess selected data sources, reporting workflows, stakeholder requirements, data ownership, refresh frequency, available history, quality gaps, and access constraints.
* Develop a structured data model and repeatable data-processing workflow for selected electricity, water, utility-system, cost, and emissions information.
* Build an interactive Power BI dashboard covering sustainability indicators, exceptions, trends, and improvement-project performance.
* Develop rule-based or AI-Enabled methods for anomaly detection, plain-language insight generation, and sustainability-opportunity prioritization.
* Create an opportunity and benefit tracker and automate selected reporting outputs using approved tools.

**Learning Opportunities**
--------------------------

* Gain practical experience with sustainability data, utility systems, data modelling, and data-quality management.
* Develop experience in Power BI dashboard design, data visualization, reporting automation, and user-centered solution development.
* Learn how Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, AI Assistants, and Agentic AI concepts may be applied responsibly to engineering analytics.
* Build knowledge of energy, water, cost, carbon, and sustainability-performance measurement.
* Collaborate with engineering, facilities, environmental, health and safety, sustainability, digital, and business stakeholders.

**Deliverables**
----------------

* A documented current-state assessment and defined minimum viable product for the selected project scope.
* A structured sustainability data model with repeatable data-ingestion, transformation, and data-quality processes.
* An interactive command-center dashboard with relevant performance indicators, trends, exceptions, and drill-down capabilities.
* An AI-Enabled analytics or alerting method and an opportunity tracker covering estimated and realized sustainability benefits.
* Technical documentation, user instructions, a data dictionary, solution architecture, maintenance guidance, and a final project presentation.

**Impact of the Project**
-------------------------

* Improve visibility into selected energy, water, carbon, cost, and utility-performance indicators.
* Enable earlier identification of unusual consumption patterns, efficiency degradation, and potential improvement opportunities.
* Reduce manual effort associated with selected sustainability reporting and opportunity-tracking activities.
* Improve the consistency and traceability of sustainability performance and benefit measurement.

**Skillsets Required**
----------------------

* Familiarity with data analytics, data modelling, data visualization, or reporting automation.
* Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Excel, Python, Structured Query Language, Power Platform, or similar tools is advantageous.
* Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, AI-Assisted analytics, or AI-Enabled workflows.
* Strong analytical, structured problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-engagement skills.
* Interest in energy management, water management, carbon accounting, facilities utilities, or environmental sustainability.

**Preferred Knowledge**
-----------------------

* Understanding of energy and water management, carbon accounting, or environmental sustainability.
* Familiarity with facilities utilities such as heating, ventilation and air conditioning, chilled water, compressed air, electrical power, or water systems.
* Knowledge of energy-performance indicators or International Organization for Standardization 50001 is advantageous.

**Course of Interest**
----------------------

The ideal candidate should be pursuing a university degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Sustainability, or a related engineering or analytics discipline.

**Duration of Period**
----------------------

The ideal candidate should be able to commit to a full time internship period of **five months, from January to May 2027**.

**Job Summary:**

Sustainability at Williams-Sonoma, Inc. (WSI) encompasses our environmental and social initiatives. In this position, you will be focused primarily on implementing a new system to support traceability, regulatory compliance and reporting. This includes interacting with our supply chain partners in WSI’s key sourcing markets. You will support suppliers to onboard into the system, troubleshoot and review data. The data captured in the system will be used for assessing risk in wood sourcing and implementing remediation with suppliers as needed. The data insights will inform WSI’s long term sustainability strategy related to responsible sourcing of materials and ensuring global regulatory compliance. An ideal candidate should have an interest in sustainability technology solutions and a firm grasp of global wood regulations.

* Ensure WSI compliance with global wood regulations ie. United Kingdom Timber Regulation, Australia’s Illegal Logging Prohibition Act, European Union Deforestation Regulation, etc.
* Monitor supplier compliance – analyze vendor supply chain mapping, complete risk assessments for compliance, recommend and support vendor remediation and ensure suppliers are submitting data in timely manner through the system’s task functions
* Support the WSI Sustainability team in achieving companywide and brand-specific goals related to responsible materials through implementation of a new technology platform for suppliers
* Supplier communication about sustainability system purpose & expectations
* Develop & execute supplier training & onboarding
* Collaborate with business, IT & other teams; provide demos and internal training.
* Manage system, including monitoring deployment of the system, resolving issues, gather feedback, and recommend changes
Help to maintain FAQ & user guides for system  

**Desired qualifications and competencies:**

* Preferably 2 years of working experience in supply chain, experience in sustainability and traceability projects is an advantage
* Preferably 2 years of experience with implementing process and best practices for complying to global wood regulations
* Fresh graduates are welcome to apply
* Tertiary education in environmental sustainability, supply chain management, technology or related fields
* Detail oriented with proven analytical skills and experience processing large amounts of data to derive insight and develop recommendations for action
* Comfortable working with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Independent and proactive in setting own goals and deadlines
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel)
* Exceptional English written and verbal communication skills (+ Mandarin is an advantage to liaise with suppliers)
* Knowledgeable about Power BI is preferred

title: Associate / Senior Associate, Climate Change and Sustainability Services, Assurance
ESG and Sustainability Manager
description:
The Responsible Business team leads and supports the firm’s environmental management and sustainability strategy (including climate, carbon and resource use), as well as human rights and wider ESG work. The team works closely with other parts of the business to coordinate activity, align environmental and social objectives, and drive measurable, ESG‑led progress.
  
  
Purpose of the Role
  
  
The ESG and Sustainability Manager will play a key role in developing and delivering Simmons & Simmons’ environmental and climate strategy across its global offices, overseeing carbon and climate‑related reporting, environmental management systems, carbon reduction programmes, supplier engagement, and green building and office projects. The role will ensure compliance with evolving ESG, regulatory and market standards and is central to delivering the firm’s Responsible Business Strategy and climate commitments, while meeting client, regulatory and wider stakeholder expectations.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
·
  
  
**Strategy & Reporting:**  
Lead the firm’s environmental and climate strategy, aligned with Responsible Business priorities. Coordinate global carbon reporting, the Climate Transition Plan and related risk/opportunity analysis. Manage key external disclosures including the Carbon Reduction Plan, SBTi requirements, climate‑related financial disclosures (CFD) and CDP, and oversee ISO 14001, ESOS and SECR processes and audits.
  
  
·
  
  
**Governance & Committees:**  
Support with the Responsible Business Board, Climate Committee and The Green Room providing insight on environmental performance, risks an d emerging regulatory developments.
  
  
·
  
  
**Environmental & Carbon Reduction Initiatives:**  
Develop and implement initiatives to reduce operational emissions and broader environmental impacts, including travel-related emissions. Coordinate environmental and sustainability training across the firm where necessary.
  
  
·
  
  
**Sustainable Procurement & Supplier Engagement:**  
Integrate sustainability into procurement and supplier management, working closely with EnterpriseRisk Management (ERM) and related teams. Lead supplier engagement under the SBT Action Plan to reduce Scope 3 emissions, set and communicate environmental expectations and track supplier performance.
  
  
·
  
  
**Offices, Real Estate& Green Buildings:**  
Provide sustainability input into office projects (including25 Finsbury Square) ensuring environmental requirements are built into design and operation. Support the facilities team with green building certifications(e.g. BREEAM, LEED) and improve building energy performance across the global estate.
  
  
·
  
  
**Charters, Memberships & External Commitments:**  
Manage participation in environmental and climate initiatives, such as the Legal 1.5°CCharter and the Legal Sustainability Alliance. Ensure commitments are embedded as part of the responsible business strategy.
  
  
·
  
  
**Horizon Scanning &Regulatory Compliance:**  
Track evolving ESG and environmental regulation and standards and prepare for key obligations (e.g. UK SRS, CSRD and CSDDD). Provide guidance on implications for the firm, and coordinate internal activity to ensure compliance.
  
  
·
  
  
**Policies:**  
Review and update environmental and other relevant policies, and ensure they are clearly communicated.
  
  
·
  
  
**Stakeholder and client support:**  
Oversee environmental and ESG input into RFPs, pitches and panel reviews and coordinate responses to client environmental audits and questionnaires. Where relevant, work with client relationship teams to articulate the firm’s environmental credentials and support client discussions on ESG topics.
  
  
Experience and personal specification
  
  

* Excellent communication, coordination and project management skills.
* Strong knowledge and understanding of ESG and environmental sustainability, including carbon accounting, climate risk, Science Based Targets (SBTi), and environmental management systems (e.g. ISO 14001).
* Experience of supporting environmental, ESG and regulatory reporting processes (e.g. SECR, ESOS, CDP, climate‑related financial disclosures), including data collection, assurance and narrative development.
* Experience setting, monitoring or reporting against KPIs, impact measures or performance indicators.
* Strong writing, editing and content development skills, including drafting clear governance papers, environmental policies, internal reports and client‑facing ESG materials.
* Experience with policy development, review and implementation.
* Confidence working with senior stakeholders, internal committees and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to work independently and make sound decisions in line with the firm’s goals and values.
